title: Post-Market Study of the Argus® II Retinal Prosthesis System - France
brief_summary: This is a post-market study of the Argus II Retinal Prosthesis System. The study is being conducted in France. The objective of the study is to obtain data to further demonstrate the effectiveness and evaluate the safety of Argus II System in patients with retinitis pigmentosa who have a bare light perception or worse in both eyes.
study_population: Patients with retinitis pigmentosa who have bare light perception or worse in both eyes
